title.en: Oct 5–11, 2026 | AI turned in 722 mathematics papers and passed 9.4% of its legal tasks
title.zh-CN: 2026 年 10 月 5 日至 11 日｜AI 交了 722 篇数学论文，法律任务只过 9.4%

description.en: What AI took over this week, what it changed, and what people are arguing about. Mathematical proofs, clinic intake and live dashboards were taken; legal documents were not; call center jobs began shrinking 4% a year. Every item links to its source.
description.zh-CN: 这一周 AI 接手了什么、带来什么影响、大家在争什么。数学证明、诊所问诊、实时看板被接了过去；法律文书没接住；呼叫中心岗位开始每年少 4%。每一条都能点回原帖。

title.en: Oct 10, 2026 | Will AI replace SaaS? What are users still paying for?
title.zh-CN: 2026 年 10 月 10 日｜AI 会取代 SaaS 吗？用户到底为什么付费

description.en: Bespoke agents, established workflows and harder-to-sell side projects point to different questions. A source-linked analysis of what it would take to replace paid software.
description.zh-CN: Agent 按需造软件、老牌 SaaS 熟悉工作流程、副业项目越来越难出售，这三条线说的是不同问题。沿原始来源，分析替代付费软件还需要做到什么。

title.en: Sep 29–Oct 7, 2026 | Judgment now costs two cents
title.zh-CN: 2026 年 9 月 29 日至 10 月 7 日｜“做判断”只值两美分了

description.en: Five threads from nine days. Decision models became a category and started a price war. Evaluations moved from answering questions to doing long jobs. People handed whole chores to agents. Large models ran on personal machines. Open-weight releases came in a cluster.
description.zh-CN: 九天里的五条线：决策模型一周内变成品类并开始价格战；评测从答题变成让模型干一件长事；有人把杂事整件交给 agent；大模型跑进了自己的机器；开放权重模型密集发布。
